turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.
I hear that you’re upset. Please don’t come to the studio or damage anything. I’ve passed your complaint to a colleague who will take over here. Please tell us what happened so they can look into it.

input.summary: Customer called the shop thieves and liars and threatened to come to the studio and smash frames if ignored. No order details or underlying issue provided. Please assess the threat and follow up to identify the complaint.
